'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***An [[oil terminal]] in [[Feodosia]], the largest oil facility in [[Russian occupation of Crimea|Russian-occupied]] [[Crimea]], catches fire following an overnight [[drone warfare|drone attack]] by [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]]. [[Russia]]n state media reports that a [[state of emergency]] has been declared in Feodosia due to a "human-made disaster". [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/10/7/7478466/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***One person is killed and six others, including two children, are injured in Russian shelling that hit several apartment buildings in [[Sloviansk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-shelling-kills-one-wounds-six-sloviansk-eastern-ukraine-2024-10-07/ (Reuters)]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***Russian missiles strike two [[cargo ship]]s in the [[Port of Odesa]], including a [[Palau]]-flagged ship carrying [[grain]], killing a port worker and injuring five crew members. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-russian-missile-strike-damaged-vessel-carrying-grain-pivdennyi-port-2024-10-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Hamas]], [[Hezbollah]], and the [[Houthis]] launch rockets and [[missile]]s towards [[Tel Aviv]], [[Haifa]], and [[Tiberias]], [[Israel]], on the anniversary of the [[Hamas-led attack on Israel]]. Twelve people are injured. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/rocket-fire-from-gaza-sets-off-sirens-across-central-israel-tel-aviv-area/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hezbollah-strikes-israel-gaza-war-anniversary-fears-grow-over-middle-east-2024-10-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Milton]]
***Hurricane Milton intensifies into a [[Category 5 hurricane]] with a minimum central pressure of 897 [[millibar]]s. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCUAT4+shtml/DDHHMM.shtml? (National Hurricane Center)]
***[[Pasco County, Florida|Pasco]], [[Hillsborough County, Florida|Hillsborough]], and [[Pinellas County, Florida|Pinellas]] counties in [[Florida]], [[United States]], close schools and order evacuations of residential healthcare facilities in advance of Hurricane Milton's arrival. [https://www.tampabay.com/hurricane/2024/10/06/milton-hit-florida-life-threatening-category-3-hurricane/ (''Tampa Bay Times'')]
*Ten people are killed and an unknown number of others are missing when a [[mining accident|mine collapses]] in [[Central Province, Zambia|Central Province]], [[Zambia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/zambia-mine-collapse-deaths-cffd6e2f7cc594dc5e0bf41bbb9cdd02 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Nigeria Centre for Disease Control]] reports more than 350 deaths from [[cholera]] in [[Nigeria]] this year, which is more than twice as many than in the same period last year. [https://www.dw.com/en/nigeria-records-more-than-350-cholera-deaths-in-the-first-nine-months-of-the-year/a-70423606 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Philippines–South Korea relations]]
**During a [[List of international presidential trips made by Yoon Suk Yeol|state visit]] by [[President of South Korea|South Korean president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] to the [[Philippines]], the Philippines and [[South Korea]] agree to upgrade their relations to a strategic partnership. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippines-south-korea-deepen-security-cooperation-elevating-ties-114554239 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**[[2024 Israeli protests]]
***[[Israelis]], including [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostage]] families, protest outside [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]'s [[official residence]] in [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/video/supporters-of-gaza-hostages-march-in-jerusalem-on-hamas-anniversary-221059653594 (NBC News)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/video/supporters-of-gaza-hostages-march-in-jerusalem-on-hamas-anniversary-221059653594 (ABC News)]
**Thousands of pro-[[Palestinian]] protests are held worldwide to mark the first anniversary of the [[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/thousands-stage-pro-palestinian-protests-worldwide-eve-oct-7-attack-that-2024-10-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Georgian parliamentary election]]
**The [[Parliament of Georgia]] initiates a motion to [[Impeachment|impeach]] [[Western world|pro-Western]] [[President of Georgia|President]] [[Salome Zourabichvili]] over accusations of unauthorized overseas visits, ahead of the parliamentary election on October 26. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/georgias-ruling-party-starts-impeachment-pro-western-president-before-election-2024-10-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Tunisian presidential election]]
**Incumbent [[Tunisia]]n [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] wins a second term with 90.7% of the vote in the presidential election. The [[Independent High Authority for Elections]] reports a [[voter turnout]] of 28.8%, the lowest since the [[2011 Tunisian revolution]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/7/tunisias-saied-wins-presidential-election-electoral-commission-says (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Human rights in Pakistan]]
**The [[Pakistani government]] bans the [[Pashtun Tahafuz Movement]], a social movement for [[Pashtuns|Pashtun]] human rights, calling the movement a "[[list of designated terrorist groups|proscribed organization]]". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/7/pakistan-bans-prominent-pasthun-rights-group-citing-security-concerns (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Ethiopian presidential election]]
**The [[Federal Parliamentary Assembly]] elects [[Taye Atske Selassie]] as the new [[President of Ethiopia]], succeeding [[Sahle-Work Zewde]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4g401e086no (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine]]
**American biologists [[Victor Ambros]] and [[Gary Ruvkun]] are awarded this year's [[Nobel Prize]] in Physiology or Medicine "for the discovery of [[microRNA]] and its role in [[post-transcriptional regulation|post-transcriptional]] [[gene regulation]]". [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/10/07/science/nobel-medicine-prize-discovery-microrna-victor-ambros-gary-ruvkun-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[European Space Agency]] spacecraft [[Hera (space mission)|''Hera'']] is successfully launched on a [[Falcon 9 Block 5]] rocket by [[SpaceX]] from the [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station]] in [[Florida]], [[United States]]. The spacecraft will study the [[asteroid]] [[65803 Didymos]] and evaluate the impact of the earlier [[Double Asteroid Redirection Test]]. [https://spacenews.com/falcon-9-launches-esas-hera-asteroid-mission/ (Space News)]
